name: cobol-copy-replace-scope-and-extensions
body: preprocess applies a REPLACE found inside a copybook at copybook level, so it ends with the copybook, and finds copybooks with the bare name or the lower- and upper-case .cpy/.cbl/.cob/.cobol extensions. Limit: copybook REPLACE does not persist past the copybook, and mixed-case extensions such as .Cbl are not found. Upgrade when a corpus needs persistent copybook REPLACE or mixed-case extensions (via a directory-listing lookup).
